findings.address_as_written: Agreement - Golden Gate Angling and Casting Club
findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners let the Golden Gate Angling and Casting Club use the new Anglers' Lodge beside the fly-casting pools west of the stadium as its headquarters, the club's old lodge on Stow Lake having lately been demolished; the club was to repair, paint and keep up the building.

citation.label: Minutes of the Board of Park Commissioners, February 15, 1940
